module.title: Shipments, Milestones and Status Timelines
module.business_purpose: Business-level tracking of anything that moves or progresses: pharmacy deliveries, lab specimen transport, ambulance dispatch, referral fulfilment, claim processing. Provides a generic trackable subject with a tracking number, a status timeline of milestones, carrier/handoff records, ETA estimates and proof-of-delivery. Consumes raw GPS from module 13 (geo) but adds the business meaning geo does not carry.
